objective: Build the MVP, sign partners, run staff beta
guardrails: No customer launch before Gate 0; shadow payday runs with staff money
decision_point: Gate 0 (month 3): partner terms signed (bank fee target VND 0); shadow runs >= 99.5% credited on time; SSC notice and adviser sign-off in writing

objective: Randomised pilot with {pilot_accounts} dormant accounts in three arms of {pilot_arm}
segment: Dormant account holders with salary signals (E2)
channels: SMS brandname, Zalo template message, push, email, Ensa; at most 3 touches per account
message: "Your account is ready. Let payday do the investing." Start from VND 500,000; no sign-up reward
guardrails: Control arm receives no offer; all terms on one screen; no conditional bonus
decision_point: Gate 1 (month 6): enrolment >= {enrol_scale} to scale, < {enrol_stop} to stop; >= {persist_scale} make 3 contributions in a row; >= 80% new money; projected net cost per new account above VND 10 million <= VND {cpa_scale} million

segment: Eligible dormant accounts (E2); active traders (E1) as a long-term core; new accounts at opening
channels: Same digital channels; in-app banner for active customers; plan step during account opening
message: E1: "Keep a core that grows while you trade." New accounts: "Start your plan with your first deposit."
guardrails: Withdrawals go to the linked bank by default; moving plan money to buying power needs a separate step; hold-out group keeps measuring the persistence package
decision_point: Monthly: funded savers and balances against the plan path; acquisition cost per funded saver <= VND {ceiling} (CAC ceiling)

channels: HR sessions with a licensed adviser; partner bank's salary customers
message: "An employee benefit that invests your salary."
guardrails: Opt-in only (no automatic enrolment assumed); payroll deduction only with each employee's written consent
decision_point: Gate 2 (month 12): funded savers >= 80% of plan ({m12_funded_80}); balances >= VND {m12_bal_80} billion; employer participation tracked against the {emp_part} needed in year 2
